_default_nz: NZX announcements at nzx.com/companies/{CODE}/announcements list results releases; company IR sites usually have a 'results' or 'investor centre' page with PDF links.
_default_l: UK-listed company. Annual reports are PDFs on the company website under Investors -> 'Results, Reports & Presentations' (search by COMPANY NAME, not ticker). AnnualReports.com mirrors many. RNS announcements are text pages, not report PDFs — do not save them.
WISE.L: owners.wise.com times out. Use GlobeNewswire or Investegate RNS mirrors. UK company: reports are 'Annual Report and Accounts', never 10-K/20-F.
V: investor.visa.com is Cloudflare-protected; use SEC EDGAR (CIK 0001403161) instead.
AFI.NZ: afi.com.au is Cloudflare-protected but assets.afi.com.au direct PDF links work.
AFC.NZ: Filings via NZX API: api.nzx.com, company code IRG000000.
